Problem Statement:
Rampal is a number in which the sum of last two digits of that number is multiple of 4.Your teacher has given you the task to make a list of rampal numbers.Your task is to tell whether the number is rampal or not. Note : if the number is negative than rampal is a number which has sum of first and last digit as multiple of 4
